Definition
[the tensors $S$ and $\operatorname {Hess}^2f$]

Source: petersen:page-0108

For a smooth function $f$ (possibly only on an open $O\subset M$), write $S(X)= abla _X abla f$ for the $(1,1)$-tensor corresponding to $\operatorname {Hess}f$, and $\operatorname {Hess}^2f$ for the $(0,2)$-tensor corresponding to $S^2=S\circ S$.
